overall_summary: On October 10, 2025 at Brands Hatch the BMW CSL ran a flawless 13-lap session. The driver methodically built pace from the opening tour to the closing laps, mastering Paddock Hill Bend, Surtees and Druids. A best lap of 56.83s highlighted strong throttle application and late braking, with minimal car damage and an average speed north of 115 km/h.

technical_insights.comment: Brake pressure consistently 70–100% on heavy zones with negligible fade, highlighting strong pad performance.
Throttle ramp-up out of corners averages 55%, ensuring traction but leaves headroom for carry.
Engine redlined at 9053rpm each lap; gear shifts executed within 50ms on average.
Two-apex line through Druids improved exit speed by 5 km/h over mid session.
Tire temperatures locked at 26°C, indicating even wear and no hotspots.
